Colour Harmony & Natural Beauty

A home inspired by the philosophy of Colores

Inspired by a holistic healing concept that uses colour to balance physical and emotional wellness, The Vividz @ Bukit Jalil is designed as a transformative experience — bright, lively hues woven through spaces that keep you in harmony with yourself and your environment.

A residential complex of two 57-storey towers with 1,138 private homes, taking full advantage of its central location and idyllic natural surroundings — with common areas that integrate nature at every level.

  • Integrated with the KL Wellness City masterplan
  • 1, 2 & 3-bedroom efficient layouts — 484 to 915 sq.ft.
  • By EXSIM × Three Towers — GreenRE eco-responsible developer
  • Targeted completion 2028
